records.definition_hu: Defines the value for scenario name in the sizing and workload simulation workflow.
records.impact_hu: Changing this field can affect workload composition, performance estimates, compatibility checks, or capacity recommendations.
records.interpretation_hu: Use a value that reflects expected production behavior rather than an ideal demo case.
records.caution_hu: Unrealistic values can make the estimate too optimistic or too conservative.
records.example_hu: Example: set scenario name to match the expected production workload.
